The color of a common crow is black.

The teacher leaned forward, her eyes crinkling with genuine approval as she handed the paper back. "I have to say, this recent assignment was quite well done. You really captured the nuance of the topic."

The student took the paper, a flush of pride warming their cheeks. "Thank you. I put a lot of extra hours into researching the details, so I'm glad it showed."

The teacher smiled warmly, wanting to reinforce that dedication. "It definitely showed. Keep that level of effort up, and you'll go far."
